title: Udo Wartena's tour of a craft with counter-rotating flywheels
summary: Mike Masters tells of Udo Wartena's tour of a craft with counter-rotating flywheels, about unspecified at unspecified, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Udo wartena he got a tour he didn't know [ __ ] about UFOs or electromagnetics of course cuz he's a minor but they explain that there's these counter rotating flywheels

plain: Mike Masters, a researcher who argues that aliens may be humans from the future, tells about a miner named Udo Wartena, who he says was given a tour of a craft. According to Masters, Wartena knew nothing about UFOs or electromagnetism, yet the beings told him the craft worked using flywheels spinning in opposite directions, which would offer a rare look at how such a craft is said to fly.
